name: stop_recording
title: Stop recording
description: Stop the currently running recording, finalize the track files and record their sizes, sha256 hashes and durations in the bundle manifest. With auto_process=true (default) a `process` job (ffmpeg split → transcription → diarization → alignment → integration → minutes) is enqueued and its job_id is returned; poll it with get_job_status. With discard_video=true the screen video track is deleted after finalization and marked discarded (audio tracks are kept); this cannot be undone. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result without enqueuing a second job. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (no recording is running), recorder_unavailable (the recorder process died or could not finalize the files), invalid_argument, internal.

auto_process.description: Enqueue a `process` job right after stopping (default true). Set false to only stop; call regenerate later to process.

discard_video.description: Delete the screen video track after stopping and mark it discarded (default false). Audio tracks are always kept. Irreversible.

tracks.description: Track name (screen / mic / system) → final file status. A discarded track has discarded=true and null sha256/bytes.

job_id.description: Present when auto_process=true: the enqueued `process` job.
